Title: Windows Server end-of-support (EOS): Upgrade seamlessly with Azure Migrate (Public preview)

Body.Content: With Azure Migrate, seamlessly upgrade legacy Windows servers while migrating to Azure, minimizing effort, downtime, and risk. By creating a copy of the server in Azure and performing the upgrade there, the impact on the original server is minimized, ensuring a secure and efficient transition. To learn more please refer to the feature blog
